correctness.rationale: Independent Haar phases ensure coefficientwise expectation vanishes unless every phase exponent is balanced. For a fixed row pair, balanced multisets give \(m\), \(2m^2-m\), and \(6m^3-9m^2+4m\) as the first three moments of its squared overlap. A forest has independent edge-ratio torus coordinates; any simple cycle has exactly \(m(m-1)\) surviving assignments in the full centered edge product. These exhaust variance and cubic moment of the centered sum. Normalization \(P=1/d+2\sum Y/(d^2m^2)\) gives all stated rational formulas. Six small-dimension exact Laurent-polynomial expansions and four simple-cycle moment expansions passed; finite checks complement but do not replace the proof.
